themes.name: Adritian
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Portfolio-blog: a tall hero with a thin, oversized site name, a featured grid of the three newest posts, then a dated list of older writing. Gold accent, humanist sans.

themes.name: Ananke
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Full-bleed accent hero with a large serif title, a two-column latest list with big editorial dates, and serif display type over a sans body.

themes.name: Archie
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Archive ledger: a framed masthead, monospace date column and one-line entries instead of cards. Serif reading text, ink-blue accent.

themes.name: Aurora Holo
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Iridescent modern theme — violet accent, gradient display headings, aurora glow hero and pill tags.

themes.name: Bear
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Nearly unstyled typographic blog: system fonts, a narrow reading column, a plain date and title list, and classic underlined links. No cards, no tags on the home list.

themes.name: Bento Grid
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: App-like bento grid home — posts as rounded cards, near-black accent, soft layered shadows.

themes.name: Blowfish
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Gradient hero with a floating pill navigation, then image-top cards that cast colored shadows. Thumbnails are generated in CSS when a post has no cover.

themes.name: Neo Brutal
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Neo-brutalist card grid — 2px black borders, hard offset shadows, chunky uppercase tags and heavy grotesque display type.

themes.name: Casper
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Dark full-bleed cover with a centered title, a three-column card grid with cover images or accent gradients, and a sans-serif display over a serif reading column.

themes.name: Chalk
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Two-column layout with a fixed, near-black sidebar (title, menu, tags, archive years) and a light reading column. Entries show a mono date, a bold title and a short pink rule. On small screens the sidebar becomes a CSS-only drawer.

themes.name: Claude Warm
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Warm cream-and-terracotta single column with a friendly author header, hairline post dividers and serif headings.

themes.name: Clean Blog
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Full-width slate masthead with a centered title over a narrow column of large post previews, each with a byline, a hairline rule and a text-only theme switch.

themes.name: Coder
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Friendly centered developer homepage: a badge with the site initial, a centered lede, numbered-style '//' section title and '>' post rows over a sans body with monospace headings. Amber accent, chip tags and prev/next cards.

themes.name: Congo
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Profile-led reading layout in the Congo spirit: a centered hero with a large initials circle, horizontal article cards with small square thumbnails and thin rings, serif headings on a sans body, and a sticky table of contents with an author footer on posts. Green accent.

themes.name: Cyberpunk Neon
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Dark navy base with neon cyan and magenta accents, glow shadows and a hero featured post over a compact recent list.

themes.name: Diary
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Journal layout: calendar-style date tiles beside cream entry cards, tilted sticker tags and a dotted notebook background.

themes.name: Dusk Lo-fi
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Moody lavender-indigo theme — lo-fi calm tones, soft indigo accent, gradient subheads, quiet dark mode.

themes.name: Frost Glass
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Glassmorphism theme — frosted translucent cards floating over a fixed sky-blue gradient mesh, sky accent.

themes.name: Ghostwriter
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Literary layout: centered serif masthead between double rules, roman-numbered contents, a 38rem reading column with drop caps and a closing ornament.

themes.name: Graphite Dev
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Dark-first developer blog — zinc ramp, cyan accent, sticky table of contents and code blocks with a language header bar.

themes.name: Gruvbox
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Retro editor layout: warm layered panels, numbered buffer lines, rotating colored tag chips and a vim-style status bar.

themes.name: Hacker
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Full-width ls -l listing: the homepage is a framed table of mode, size, modified date and slug with the title beside it, under a '$ cat posts/' heading. Green accent with red warning flags on a neutral charcoal, a power-icon toggle, and posts laid out as framed documents with a sectioned contents list.

themes.name: Hello Friend
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Centered lowercase logo block, dotted-underline titles and a single-column stream of short entries with plain #tags.

themes.name: Hermit
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Quiet dark-first writing room: one narrow column, a small teal-glowing title, and every list drawn as title, dotted leader and right-aligned date. No cards and no tag boxes; tags are plain '· tag' text. Serif body with monospace dates.

themes.name: HPSTR
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Photo-essay layout: a huge title band, alternating image and text rows in old-print frames with grain, spaced capitals for tags, and a drop cap on posts.

themes.name: Hyde
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: A full-height accent sidebar holds the site identity, menu and tags; the posts run in a classic serif column beside it. The sidebar can sit on the left or the right.

themes.name: Klise
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Greeting-led personal blog: a sticky blurred navbar, a large 'Hi, I'm' hero, and posts grouped by year under faded year numerals. Rounded type, red accent, switch-style dark mode.

themes.name: Lagrange
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Editorial serif journal: a large serif introduction, then wide image-led entries separated by hairlines. Tags are small capitals, not boxes. Post pages open with a drop cap and a contents list.

themes.name: Lanyon
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Oversized heavy grotesque headlines on a white roll of posts. The site menu lives in a slide-out drawer opened from a hamburger, built with a checkbox and CSS only. The drawer can open from the left or the right.

themes.name: Long Haul
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: A long-form reading list. Each post is a numbered entry with its reading time set large in the margin. Posts read in a serif column on warm paper, with a numbered table of contents that sticks to the left margin and a reading progress rule along the top.

themes.name: LoveIt
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Dated timeline in the LoveIt spirit: a blurred sticky navbar with a switch toggle, summaries marked by a cyan left rule with inline SVG meta icons, and a sticky table of contents beside posts.

themes.name: Meditor
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Editorial front page: a huge lead headline with two side stories, a numbered Topics column and a dense dated list. Deep blue accent and sharp Bodoni-style serif headlines.

themes.name: Mediumish
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Medium-style home: a featured story beside two stacked cards, then a three-column grid with author and date meta. Green accent, sans UI with serif reading text.

themes.name: Minima
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Jekyll-classic layout: title and underlined menu in a thin header, bold small dates above post titles, a serif reading face and a cool blue-grey palette, with a three-column footer.

themes.name: Mint Fresh
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Airy mint-teal minimal theme — generous whitespace, pill tags, animated underlines, calm dark mode.

themes.name: Minimal Mistakes
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: A blue masthead over a sticky author-style sidebar. Posts appear as a two-column grid of teaser cards, and each post gets a sticky table of contents on the right and pill tags at the foot.

themes.name: Neutral
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Minimal single-column blog theme — true grays, near-white background, generous whitespace, one accent.

themes.name: Vintage Paper
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Personal journal — cream paper texture, ink-brown serif text, left archive sidebar and italic pull-quotes.

themes.name: PaperMod
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Compact single-column blog in the PaperMod spirit: a home-info block, short bold entry cards with two-line summaries, a collapsible table of contents on posts, and one red-orange accent on a system sans.

themes.name: Catppuccin Soft
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Newsletter-style centered column on Catppuccin latte/mocha — author card, dated entries and a subscribe CTA.

themes.name: Pop Play
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Playful pop theme — chunky rounded cards, thick ink borders, hard offset shadows, vivid pink-and-yellow palette.

themes.name: Sage Garden
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Classic blog layout with a right sidebar — search, recent posts and an about card on soft forest greens.

themes.name: Elegant Editorial
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Newspaper-style editorial — centered serif masthead with rules, dateline, and a featured grid on ivory with muted gold.

themes.name: Clean Slate Magazine
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Magazine split layout — oversized masthead, lead story with 16:9 cover, and a hairline latest list on cool professional blues.

themes.name: Stack
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Three-column reading layout in the Hugo Stack spirit: a persistent profile sidebar with a round initials badge, tag cloud and menu, wide cards with thumbnails on the right, and an archive-by-year widget on wide screens. Indigo accent on a cool grey page.

themes.name: Studio Grid
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Clean modern studio look — wide measure, uppercase micro-labels, indigo accent, precise hairlines and calm grays.

themes.name: Sunset Fade
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Warm modern gradient theme — coral-orange accent, gradient hero heading, soft shadows on cream.

themes.name: Swiss Typo
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: International typographic style — black on white, zero radius, heavy rules, uppercase display headings and a red accent.

themes.name: Terminal
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Phosphor-green shell session on black: a reader@host prompt with a blinking cursor, [ bracketed ] navigation, post lists printed like command output and a '# ' heading on every post. Optional CRT scanlines.

themes.name: Tokyo Night
themes.author: goblog
themes.description: Dark-first neon theme from the Tokyo Night palette — blue/cyan glow accents, mono metadata, glowing post cards.
